items.headline: Jalen Hurts reportedly out for the season with blood clots
items.summary: The Eagles quarterback is being treated with blood thinners for deep vein thrombosis and clots in his lungs, according to ESPN's Adam Schefter. The team and his agent released a joint statement on his treatment plan.

items.headline: Colts fire general manager Chris Ballard after loss to the Titans
items.summary: Indianapolis announced the move Monday, a day after a 26-20 loss to Tennessee. Coach Shane Steichen said Daniel Jones stays the starter despite two interceptions.

items.headline: Nylander questionable for Toronto against San Jose with an illness
items.summary: William Nylander (5 goals, 12 points in 9 games) missed the morning skate. Toronto is already without John Tavares, who is out week to week.

items.headline: Rams receiver Davante Adams leaves loss to Arizona with a knee injury
items.summary: Adams went out with an apparent left knee injury in the 18-16 loss to the Cardinals; the Rams have not given details.

items.headline: Chiefs move to 5-0 as Kenneth Walker runs for two touchdowns
items.summary: Walker ran for 128 yards in a 22-6 win over the Chargers, who fall to 0-6. Los Angeles played without Ladd McConkey (concussion).

items.headline: Falcons safety Kendal Daniels taken off on a stretcher with a neck injury
items.summary: Daniels left the loss to Chicago in the third quarter and went to hospital for evaluation. The team said he was alert and had movement in his extremities.

items.headline: Steelers erase a 13-point fourth-quarter deficit to beat the Buccaneers in overtime
items.summary: Pittsburgh won 26-19 to reach 4-2 after two late interceptions by Tampa Bay's Jalon Daniels. The Buccaneers are 1-5.

items.headline: Unbeaten 49ers host the Commanders on Monday Night Football
items.summary: San Francisco (5-0) is a 7.5-point favourite with a total around 51. Washington is without Marcus Mariota and Jacory Croskey-Merritt, and Stefon Diggs is questionable.

items.headline: Kaprizov's power-play goal lifts the Wild past the Blue Jackets 2-1
items.summary: Minnesota outshot Columbus 34-14, with Matt Boldy putting six shots on goal. Adam Fantilli scored for Columbus.

items.headline: Flames end Carolina's seven-game winning streak with a 3-2 win
items.summary: Yegor Sharangovich scored the winner on six shots and Morgan Frost added a goal and an assist. Carolina outshot Calgary 36-34.

items.headline: Browns beat Ravens 13-10 on a last-second field goal
items.summary: Andre Szmyt hit a 37-yarder as time expired after Cleveland erased a 10-0 first-quarter hole. Derrick Henry ran for 58 yards and lost a fumble with Tyler Huntley at quarterback.

items.headline: Caleb Williams returns as Bears beat Falcons 31-23
items.summary: Williams completed 30 of 36 in his first game back from a hamstring injury, and D'Andre Swift ran for two touchdowns. Atlanta lost three fumbles.

items.headline: Patriots hold off Jets 26-19 for a third straight win
items.summary: Drake Maye threw three touchdowns as A.J. Brown returned from his ankle injury. Elsewhere, Carolina won 25-14 in Philadelphia and Tennessee beat Indianapolis 26-20 with a blocked-punt touchdown.

items.headline: Eagles place Jalen Hurts on injured reserve with a calf blood clot
items.summary: Hurts will miss at least four games, and Tanner McKee starts Sunday against Carolina. Philadelphia also ruled out guard Landon Dickerson and several others.

items.headline: Panthers rout Kraken 8-3 for a third straight game with a natural hat trick
items.summary: Carter Verhaeghe and Sam Bennett each scored three for Florida, a first in NHL history across three consecutive games. Elsewhere Saturday, McDavid had five points as Edmonton beat Utah 6-2.

items.headline: Broncos beat Seahawks 17-14 in overtime on Thursday night
items.summary: Wil Lutz won it with a 53-yard field goal after an interception. Nik Bonitto had five sacks as Denver won despite gaining only 168 yards.

items.headline: Lamar Jackson out again; Tyler Huntley starts at Cleveland
items.summary: Jackson misses a second straight game with an ankle injury. The 4-1 Ravens visit the 3-2 Browns at 1 p.m. ET.

items.headline: Maple Leafs lose John Tavares week-to-week
items.summary: Tavares was hurt in Thursday's overtime loss to Buffalo, and Chris Tanev is also week-to-week. Toronto lost 4-1 to the Islanders without him on Saturday.

items.headline: Caleb Williams expected to return for Bears against Falcons
items.summary: Williams has missed three games with a hamstring injury but practiced fully this week. Michael Penix Jr. is cleared to start for Atlanta.

items.headline: A.J. Brown activated by Patriots; 49ers rule out Bosa and Samuel for Monday
items.summary: New England activated Brown from his ankle injury for the Jets game. Unbeaten San Francisco will be without Nick Bosa and Deebo Samuel against Washington, which ruled out QB Marcus Mariota.

items.headline: MacKinnon has goal, three assists as Avalanche rally past Penguins 5-2
items.summary: Nathan MacKinnon had a power-play goal and three assists and Artturi Lehkonen scored twice as Colorado erased an early 2-0 deficit; T.J. Hughes scored his first NHL goal. Sidney Crosby's assist was his 1,110th, moving him into sole possession of seventh in NHL history.

items.headline: Bruins escape 2-goal hole, beat Ducks 4-2 for DiPietro's first NHL win
items.summary: Boston went 3-for-3 on the power play to rally from 2-0 down; David Pastrnak's tying goal was his 423rd, passing Brad Marchand for fourth on the Bruins' all-time list. Michael DiPietro made 25 saves and Boston (6-2-0) has won four straight.

items.headline: Leafs' John Tavares week-to-week with lower-body injury
items.summary: Tavares was hurt in Thursday's 5-4 OT loss to Buffalo and is listed week-to-week (roughly 1-6 weeks). He had 7 points in 7 games; Easton Cowan moves to the second line and Gavin McKenna takes his top power-play spot before Saturday's home game vs. the Islanders.

items.headline: Saturday NHL slate: 14 games, Penguins on back-to-back at Vegas
items.summary: Covers previews all 14 Saturday games, noting Pittsburgh plays in Vegas (7-2) on the second half of a back-to-back, Thatcher Demko is out for Vancouver at Tampa, and Jeremy Swayman (rested Friday) faces a winless Kings team that has the league's worst penalty kill.

items.headline: Maple Leafs acquire Aatu Raty from Canucks
items.summary: Toronto acquired center Aatu Raty from Vancouver in exchange for Jacob Quillan and Brandon Buhr; separately, Dallas signed David Perron to a one-year contract.

items.headline: Lamar Jackson and three other Ravens ruled out vs. Browns
items.summary: Jackson (ankle) will miss his second straight game, and Tyler Huntley makes a second straight start for the 4-1 Ravens at 3-2 Cleveland. C Cam Jurgens (concussion), DT Broderick Washington Jr. and TE Matt Hibner are also out; Trey Hendrickson returns with no designation.

items.headline: Baker Mayfield ruled out; Bucs host Steelers without their starter
items.summary: Mayfield (right thumb) is out for Sunday's game against Pittsburgh after Todd Bowles called him too early to tell midweek. Chiefs WR Rashee Rice and Texans RB David Montgomery are also out for Week 6.

items.headline: Eagles rule out Saquon Barkley and Jalen Hurts vs. Panthers
items.summary: Philadelphia's final Week 6 report has RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring), QB Jalen Hurts (superficial blood clot) and EDGE Jalyx Hunt out, while WR DeVonta Smith will play. Yahoo reports Tanner McKee will start at QB.

items.headline: Raiders-Bills Week 6 injury report: 3 Raiders ruled out
items.summary: Las Vegas ruled out DT Tonka Hemingway (concussion), TE Carter Runyon (foot) and WR Dont'e Thornton Jr. (hamstring). Buffalo lists WR DJ Moore (shoulder), DL Ed Oliver (knee), WR Joshua Palmer, CB Dee Alford and DL T.J. Sanders as questionable.

items.headline: Broncos edge Seahawks 17–14 in overtime on Thursday Night Football
items.summary: Denver won with only 168 yards of offense. Its defense sacked Sam Darnold five times and intercepted him twice, and Wil Lutz hit a 53-yard field goal in overtime. Jaxon Smith-Njigba had 12 catches for 134 yards.

items.headline: Eagles rule Jalen Hurts out against the Panthers
items.summary: Hurts has a superficial blood clot in his calf that moved on a follow-up exam. Philadelphia has set no return date.

items.headline: Too early to tell if Baker Mayfield plays in Week 7
items.summary: Todd Bowles said the Buccaneers quarterback's thumb injury leaves his status for Sunday undecided.

items.headline: Crosby and MacKinnon meet again as Penguins visit Avalanche
items.summary: The Nova Scotia friends face off for the 21st time tonight at 9 p.m. ET. Colorado is 4-2-1 and Pittsburgh 3-3-1.

items.headline: Pastrnak one goal from passing Marchand on Bruins list
items.summary: Boston goes for a fourth straight win in Anaheim at 10 p.m. ET. Jeremy Swayman is 5-1-0 with a 1.99 GAA, and Ducks captain Mikael Granlund opened the season with a six-game point streak.

items.headline: Tanev week to week; Eklund out 10–12 weeks; Staal out 1–2 months
items.summary: Maple Leafs defenseman Chris Tanev went on injured reserve, Senators forward William Eklund had ankle tendon surgery, and Hurricanes captain Jordan Staal has a calf tear.

fantasyWeeks.label: Week 6
fantasyWeeks.method: For each defense I computed PPR points allowed per game to each position from season box-score totals (QB: 0.04/pass yd, 4/pass TD, −2/INT, 0.1/rush yd, 6/rush TD). Dividing by the league average gives a matchup factor. With only five games per team, I shrink each factor halfway toward 1.00, then multiply it by the player's season PPR average to project this week.
fantasyWeeks.notes: Matchup factor 1.20 means the defense has allowed about 20% more than average after shrinking for sample size. Lamar Jackson is out (Tyler Huntley starts), so he is off the QB list; Hurts and Mayfield are also out, which lowers the Eagles' and Buccaneers' passing games without changing their opponents' matchup grades. Re-check inactives about 90 minutes before kickoff.
